{{Quote|My grandpa always told me 'Don't watch your credits; watch your health.' So while I was watching my health, someone stole my credits!|Droogan|<ref name="Evil Plans">{{TCW|Evil Plans}}</ref>}}
'''Droogan's grandfather''' was a [[Khramboan/Legends|Khramboan]].

==Biography==
When the [[Merchant/Legends|merchant]] [[Droogan/Legends|Droogan]] haggled the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] for [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]], he relayed a supposed saying of his grandfather, ''"Don't watch your credits, watch your health"''. Droogan claimed that this was wrong, and stated that while focusing on his health, at one point he was robbed.
